text: Looking back at November 2020, the phrase most of us said was "national defense authorization act": 15 of us, peaking November 18. That same day, 10 of us said "national defense authorization act ndaa", and 8 of us said "ndaa conference committee". Also on November 18, 11 of us said "around the world", and 9 of us said "leader kevin mccarthy". On November 11, nine of us said "on veterans day". On November 20, nine of us said "fair access to", and eight of us said "of the comptroller of the currency". We converged on the defense authorization act and its committee more than on anything else in the record from this month. First said in earlier sessions, these phrases returned to us here. That is what we said, and how many of us said it.

top_phrases.phrase: of the comptroller of the currency
